title: Business Analyst Intern
intro: Previously completed an internship as a Business Analyst Intern at Telkom Indonesia that focused on digital product analysis, market trend monitoring, and strategic insight development to support business decisions.
jobdesk: Analyze 6 Telkom Indonesia digital products against competitors by comparing pricing, features, and business processes.
Develop competitor benchmarking for 6 digital products across 18 service categories.
Create weekly reports covering 3 competitor movements and 1 AI use case.
Research and analyze 17 AI APIs from 5 providers based on pricing, features, and market positioning.
Maintain digital product pricing data and pricing history using Microsoft 365 Excel and internal NDE.
Prepare meeting minutes and document key decisions and follow-up actions.
